# ABC11 WTVD

> > ABC11 WTVD is the primary news source for the Raleigh-Durham-Fayetteville region, delivering breaking news, live streaming, weather forecasts, and local coverage across North Carolina.

ABC11 WTVD serves the Triangle area and surrounding North Carolina communities with comprehensive local news coverage, First Alert Weather forecasts, and community programming. The station provides real-time breaking news, live streaming capabilities, and hyperlocal coverage of Raleigh, Durham, Fayetteville, Wake County, and regional areas.
